prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a wide pedestrian walkway on a large suspension bridge with a waist-high railing, standard lamp posts and the city skyline in daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Vietnamese person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome male model face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, a firm jaw and straight dark brows, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth warm light-tan skin, a confident smirk, soft pastel-pink hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on copper chain (a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron hammer head, an iron round bell, a copper ship's anchor, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver miniature anvil, an iron pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.

It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful but not exaggerated. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries solid thick stained glass fused to his form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
